learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn special position words that tell us exactly where things are hiding!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Prepositions are small but very helpful words. They tell us where a person animal or thing is placed.
The cat is IN the box. The apple is ON the table. The dog is UNDER the bed. These are all position words!

fun_activity.title: 🧸 The Toy Game
fun_activity.instructions: Take your favorite toy. Put it ON your bed then IN a box and then UNDER a chair!

quick_recap: ⭐ Prepositions tell us the position of naming words.
⭐ Words like in on under and near are prepositions.
⭐ They answer the question Where is it?
